# Peter.nz

## Who
- Claude code user, LLM accuracy measurement specialist, ISO 42001 lead.
- Technical AI consultant: LLM reliability and evaluation, RAG and agent architecture, AI governance.

- MSc Computer Science, University of Auckland.
- Currently a Senior Developer at Nylon, leading their ISO 42001 implementation.
